title: dianthus caryophyllus f. brevifolius
intro: Dianthus caryophyllus f. brevifolius, commonly known as carnation, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. The carnation plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of carnation include soothing anxiety, calming digestive issues, and alleviating respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
